payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates k=1..n-1: for divisors of n, checks if all residue class bit-sum parity even; for non-divisors, uses GCD condition to count. No search tree.
payload.rationale: Solution directly computes answer using number theory (parity of residue sums, GCD) without exploring solution space, pruning, backtracking, or state search. No branch-and-bound structure; mislabeled as complete_search.
